description: Ledger of the real evidence behind every token, contract and rule. Each citation id used in a 'cite' or 'measuredFrom' field resolves here to a file in the SOURCE PROJECT (the Glaze clone that sits next to design-repo/), a line range and strings that must appear inside that range. extraction/verify_all.py checks range validity and content when the source is present, and only WARNS (never fails) when design-repo/ is used standalone. The paths are project-relative, not machine paths. Also recorded here (all produced by the extraction/*.mjs evidence tools and re-checked offline by verify_all.py): routeTable, sectionHeights, typographyChecks, layoutChecks, contentBudgets.

sourceProject.name: Glaze clone (React 18, Vite 5, Tailwind 3.4)
sourceProject.origin: Glaze by Raycast, a real, live commercial site. Clone is a study copy; its copy, brand marks, app icons and screenshots are not licensed for reuse.
sourceProject.measuredWith: Playwright, Chromium, 1440x900, 768x1024 and 390x844 (type probes at all three; section heights at 1440), CLONE_SPEC.md and specs/SPEC_*.md (live-site measurements recorded by the clone's authors)

scope.decision: Every route of the clone's real route table (src/route-modules/*.js, recorded in routeTable) is modelled by one of 13 templates. Only two states are deliberately not templates: the in-page 'App not found' state of /app/<unknown slug> and the search / pagination states (?q=, ?page=, ?entriesQuery=, ?entriesPage=) of the store and awards pages, which render on the same routes.
scope.linkPolicy: Internal nav, footer, blog, store and legal links in the clone are local routes (router Link). Sign-in and download targets, the manual, Raycast, the sponsor, jurors' sites and the social profiles are absolute external URLs. External domains (YouTube, Raycast, x.com, reddit, slack, anthropic.com, github.com, ...) are intentionally not cloned; reference examples use example.com placeholders and generated examples use reserved .example hosts.

evidenceLevels.measured: CLONE_SPEC.md Playwright-computed values and matching src values
evidenceLevels.code: read from src/ only (e.g. mobile-device CTA variant, which CLONE_SPEC says was read from code, not rendered)

sourceSnapshot.description: First 16 hex of sha256 of each cited file at build time. A mismatch in a sibling source is a WARNING that the snapshot is stale (MASTER-GUIDE 3.10), not an error.

sectionHeights.measuredWith: Playwright Chromium; getBoundingClientRect().height of the element matching each section contract source.domSelector; 1500ms settle for entrance animations

content.legal-header.selector: main section h1, main section h1 + p

majorityAccepted.justification: A legal document is one continuous text column of flat h2/h3/p/ul siblings with no wrapper per clause; the title header and the footer are separate sections, so the body is the page by nature.
An article is a header, a cover and a footer around one prose column; the prose body is the article, and the cover, header, footer and CTA are already separate sections.
The category page is a carousel, a title row with chips and one paged grid of up to 24 rows; the grid is the listing the page exists for and the carousel and chip row above it are separate sections.

routeTable.note: /store (no category) and /app/<unknown slug>: the router matches /app/:slug for ANY slug; an unknown slug renders the in-page "App not found" state (AppPage.jsx), which is not a separate route. /blog/:slug validates against the post list, so an unknown slug falls to the catch-all. /store/:category validates against the category map. /m and the six showcase tab ids are not registered and fall to the catch-all.

contentBudgets.description: Longest real source string (words) or longest real array (items) behind each section content field. verify_all.py check 14: a section contract budget must not be lower than these. Re-measure with extraction/measure_content_budgets.mjs --write.

typographyChecks.measuredWith: Playwright Chromium, getComputedStyle of the first match of each probe selector, 1200ms settle, external requests blocked

layoutChecks.measuredWith: Playwright Chromium, getComputedStyle / getBoundingClientRect of the first match of each probe selector, 1200ms settle, external requests blocked

specCrossCheck.measuredWith: Playwright Chromium, document.documentElement.scrollHeight, 1200ms settle, external requests blocked
